conclusion: Traversing OGRE 14's scene graph costs 21.24 ms of a 31.08 ms frame, 68.3 percent. Revalidating the capture costs 0.0002 ms. There is no in-place optimisation available: the cost is inherent to sourcing the scene from OGRE 14 every frame.
notes: Revalidation was the candidate for a cheap fix, since the scene is mostly static. It is free. The cost is entirely the traversal.
The OGRE 14 scene path, producing the scene and then walking it, is 25.98 ms of the 31.08 ms frame.
Everything that would survive a native scene source - dispatch, snapshot production, normalization and remainder - totals 5.10 ms.

That residual is a ceiling, not a prediction. A native scene source has a cost of its own that is not yet measured, and the same phase seam will measure it so the replacement is compared rather than assumed free.
This confirms the roadmap's stated endpoint, removal of the hidden OGRE 14 producer, as the correct and only remaining optimisation for this path.
